name: Bicep: App Service / Function insecure transport
attack_scenario: a man-in-the-middle downgrades or intercepts the plaintext HTTP/FTP channel and steals session cookies, deployment credentials, or injects a tampered app payload
negative_test_hint: submit a template with "httpsOnly: false" and assert the policy check rejects it, requiring HTTPS-only and TLS 1.2 or newer

exemplar.explanation: On Microsoft.Web sites, httpsOnly:false serves the app over plaintext HTTP (no HTTP->HTTPS redirect); siteConfig minTlsVersion '1.0'/'1.1' negotiates deprecated TLS; ftpsState:'AllAllowed' permits plaintext FTP deployments. CIS Azure App Service requires HTTPS-only, TLS 1.2+, and FTPS-only/disabled. Enforcing those keeps session cookies and deployment credentials off interceptable channels.
